description: Check the interior of a book (Innenteil) against the limits of a print-on-demand service before upload. Read-only. Each limit comes from the call or, when omitted, from the server configuration (print_on_demand); a check without a limit is reported as skipped – take the values from the printer's current specification. Checks[] {check, status pass|fail|skipped, required, actual, findings[]}: page_count (min_page_count, max_page_count, page_count_multiple); inside_margin (the inside margin, Bundsteg, of every page against the tier for the page count: inside_margin_tiers [{max_pages, min_mm}], the first tier whose max_pages is not below the page count); outside_margins (outside, top and bottom margin of every page against min_outside_margin_mm); bleed (on facing pages the inside bleed must be 0 – InDesign keeps it as left/inside –, top, bottom and outside equal bleed_mm within bleed_tolerance_mm (default 0.1), and objects reaching beyond the trim need bleed at all); objects_in_margin (objects that do not bleed but come closer to the trim than the minimum margins); objects_across_spine (facing pages: objects reaching over the spine into the facing page – cut off there when the inside bleed is 0); min_font_size (every text run, also on parent pages and in overset text, against min_font_size_pt); image_resolution (effective ppi of placed pixel images against min_ppi; placed PDF/EPS are skipped); fonts (every document font installed and allowed for PDF embedding – whether the fonts are really embedded only the exported PDF shows). Returns passed (no check failed), failed_checks[], skipped_checks[], page_count, facing_pages, page_size_mm, checks[], findings_total and findings_truncated (max_findings, default 200, over all checks). Export for upload with export_pdf and use_document_bleed true.

bleed_mm.description: Required bleed at top, bottom and outside in mm.

bleed_tolerance_mm.description: Allowed difference to bleed_mm in mm. Default 0.1.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

inside_margin_tiers.description: Inside margin (Bundsteg) per page-count tier, one entry per tier in any order.

max_pages.description: Upper page count of this tier.

min_mm.description: Smallest inside margin (Bundsteg) in mm for this tier.

max_findings.description: Cap for findings over all checks. Default 200.

min_outside_margin_mm.description: Smallest outside, top and bottom margin in mm.

min_ppi.description: Lowest effective resolution of pixel images. Default: the configured min_ppi.

page_count_multiple.description: The page count must be a multiple of this (e.g. 2 for an even count).

name: check_print_on_demand
title: Check a book for print-on-demand
